## Personality

Gertie Pye is known for her dishonest nature, with a reputation for being a cheat. She also displays a jealous attitude toward Julia, frequently making disparaging remarks about her behind her back.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P47](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0047)_

## History

Gertie Pye was a classmate of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returned to school following a brief absence, she joined Gertie and her other classmates, who all welcomed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back warmly.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P28](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gertie-pye--jane-andrews.md)

Gertie Pye and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) are acquaintances and fellow canvassers within the community. Their relationship is grounded in their shared participation in local civic activities, such as working together on canvassing efforts. They have maintained a friendly acquaintance with one another since their early involvement in these town matters.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_
